up: Retrieve activity details for the compound with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1173655 (AFATINIB) and all its salts. Use the molecule_hierarchy table to find all related compounds: first get the molregno for CHEMBL1173655 from molecule_dictionary, then get all rows from molecule_hierarchy where parent_molregno equals that molregno (including the parent itself). Join these molregnos to molecule_dictionary (to get compound_chembl_id), compound_structures (to get canonical_smiles), compound_records (to get compound_key), and activities (via activities.molregno or compound_records.record_id). Filter activities to those with standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM' and where the assay target is CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor) identified by joining activities.assay_id to assays and assays.tid to target_dictionary. Return exactly the following columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (from compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id when available, otherwise docs.doi, from docs joined via activities.doc_id), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units (from activities), activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), and target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Do not limit the number of rows; include all qualifying records.
sql:
WITH afatinib_parent AS (
    SELECT molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary
    WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
),
all_compounds AS (
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN afatinib_parent ap ON mh.parent_molregno = ap.molregno
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key AS compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM all_compounds ac
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = ac.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = ac.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = ac.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
WHERE
    a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
